summary:
USER_CONTEXT: Fix dotenv parsing so an empty unquoted value followed by whitespace and an inline comment (e.g. `KEY= # explanation`) parses as the empty string. Hash characters without preceding whitespace (`KEY=#literal`, `KEY=a#b`) must remain literal. Preserve quoting, exports, and ordinary comments. Only edit `src/dotenv/parser.py`; do not modify tests, docs, other modules, or dependencies. Finish once implementation is ready.

TASK_TRACKING: Task ID: r3-empty_inline_comment — Status: IN_PROGRESS (implementation attempted, host tests failing)

COMPLETED: Read TASK.md, README.md, src/dotenv/main.py, src/dotenv/parser.py, tests/test_parser.py. Diagnosed root cause: `_equal_sign` regex (`=[^\S\r\n]*`) consumes whitespace after `=`, so for `KEY= # explanation` the value part starts at `#`, and `parse_unquoted_value`'s strip regex `\s+#.*` finds no preceding whitespace, returning `"# explanation"` instead of `""`. Proposed fix: revert `_equal_sign` to `=` and keep `parse_unquoted_value` stripping comments only when whitespace precedes `#` via `re.sub(r"\s+#.*", "", part).rstrip()`. Submitted via FinishAction.

PENDING: Fix failing host tests for empty inline comment parsing; re-verify implementation.

CURRENT_STATE: Host tests failed (4 failures, all in `test_empty_comment`). Failing parametrized cases: `'KEY= # note'`, `'KEY=  # note'`, `'KEY=\t# note'`, `'export KEY = # note'`. Test asserts `dotenv_values(stream=io.StringIO(line))` yields empty string value. Implementation not yet correct.

CODE_STATE: File: src/dotenv/parser.py. Key elements: `make_regex()`, `_equal_sign` regex, `parse_unquoted_value()` (uses `re.sub(r"\s+#.*", "", part).rstrip()`). Other files read-only: src/dotenv/main.py, tests/test_parser.py.

TESTS: tests/test_parser.py::test_empty_comment — 4 failures for inputs `'KEY= # note'`, `'KEY=  # note'`, `'KEY=\t# note'`, `'export KEY = # note'`. Error: assertion on `dotenv_values(stream=io.StringIO(line))` value mismatch (expected empty string).

CHANGES: Attempted edit to `_equal_sign` (revert to `=`) and `parse_unquoted_value` comment-stripping regex — did not resolve failures.

DEPS: None modified (imports: codecs, re, typing).

VERSION_CONTROL_STATUS: Not tracked in events.
